subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR keep the runtime legacy no-code diagnostic invalidation path, or should legacy cleanup move to doctor/migration-owned code before merge?
rationale: The explicit marker follows the prior maintainer direction, but the legacy fallback changes upgrade behavior for persisted SQLite diagnostics written before the marker existed, which is a compatibility-sensitive runtime decision.

options.title: Keep Runtime Fallback After Proof
options.body: Require redacted latest-head proof for the legacy SQLite row and then land the runtime invalidation path as the bounded upgrade behavior.

options.title: Land Marker Only
options.body: Remove the legacy no-code branch and land only the explicit marker plus schema preservation, leaving pre-marker rows to a later repair path.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor
options.body: Pause this PR until the legacy no-code cleanup is implemented in doctor or migration code instead of steady-state registry loading.

recommendation.title: Keep Runtime Fallback After Proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted latest-head proof for the legacy SQLite row and then land the runtime invalidation path as the bounded upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They gave the explicit-marker direction on the predecessor and merged related plugin registry stale-source work.
